{{Quote|It ''is'' Ackbar, Han! I recognize his admiral's uniform!|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="It's a Trap">"[[It's a Trap]]"</ref>}}
A '''Mon Cal uniform jerkin''' was an [[Color/Legends|off-white]] sleeveless jacket worn by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] military personnel. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] wore such a jerkin during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
